summary: Dr. Michael Bilikas and Associates, doing business as 32 Pearls, a dental practice with locations in Seattle and Tacoma in Washington state, has recently disclosed a security incident that was detected on May 22, 2025. Ransomware was used to encrypt files on its systems, and third-party cybersecurity experts were engaged to determine the scope of the incident. They concluded that the ransomware actor had access to certain systems between May 19, 2025, and May 22, 2025, and may have viewed or acquired files containing patient data. The file review has recently been completed, and notifications are being sent to 23,517 current and former patients, who have been offered complimentary credit monitoring and identity theft protection services. Information exposed in the incident included full names, addresses, driver’s license numbers, Social Security numbers, and medical information.
